name: promptcraft-pro
description: Design, adapt, and evaluate clear, bounded, testable prompts for your target language model.

interface.longDescription: Create, improve, adapt, and evaluate prompts for your target language model. PromptCraft Pro clarifies goals, audience, inputs, constraints, output format, and risk; produces a ready-to-copy prompt; and adds concrete verification checks. For important workflows, it helps define representative tests, failure conditions, and human review. Model-specific advice relies on current documentation when available. It runs as a skill in your host assistant: it does not call other model APIs, run cross-model benchmarks, or guarantee outcomes. Free and open source under the MIT License.
defaultPrompt: Turn my goal into a self-contained prompt with a clear output format and verification checks.
Improve this prompt for my target model while preserving my constraints and terminology.
Evaluate this prompt and propose representative test cases and failure conditions.

prompts: اكتب لي prompt لتحويل ملاحظات اجتماع إلى قرارات ومهام بصيغة جدول، دون اختراع أسماء أو مواعيد.
Improve this prompt for ChatGPT: summarize customer feedback. Preserve uncertainty and require evidence from the supplied feedback.
Evaluate this extraction prompt and propose tests for missing fields, conflicting instructions in the source, and invalid output.
